metadata.description: Memex plugins for coding agents: light-touch spec-checkout hooks. The Memex MCP server is installed by `npx -y memex-ai install`, so a single browser sign-in serves both the MCP and the checkout key.

plugins.name: memex-checkout
plugins.description: Binds your coding thread to a Memex Spec and records in-flow edits against it (claim-gated, privacy-first). Hooks-only and trivially uninstallable; the Memex MCP is installed by `npx -y memex-ai install` (one sign-in serves both, no duplicate toolset). Sends only changed file paths + the claimed spec; never source code or prompts.
